response.sql: SELECT AVG(g.avg_fill) AS result FROM (SELECT oe.ordersmark, o.orderflow, AVG(oe.fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions oe JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark WHERE oe.expirespot > '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND oe.expirespot < '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.orderflow) g

assumptions.assumption: The expiry comparison is done as text (string comparison) on expirespot, as the request states, with both bounds exclusive. Rows with NULL expirespot are dropped.
An inner join to orders is used. If several orders shared the same recordvault, they would be counted as separate rows, but recordvault is treated as unique.
The final result is the unweighted average of per-group averages. Groups whose average is NULL are ignored by AVG.
